spec.claim_summary: Bitcoin short strategy sells Saturday and buys back Wednesday to avoid weak Sundays, covering when price is rising.
assumptions: Asset BTC from page context; chart timeframe 1d stated in claim.
Compiled 'sells on Saturday, and buys back the next Wednesday' as a short held over the weekend: short entry Saturday, cover after the weekend.

NOT EXPRESSIBLE: cover requires Wednesday AND price rising on the same bar, but exit conditions are OR so an AND cover cannot be expressed; exit is approximated by weekday alone and the 'kinda going up' trend filter on the cover is omitted from the test.

NOT EXPRESSIBLE: exact Wednesday cover cannot be expressed with OR exits (gt plus lt would be a tautology), so exit uses day_of_week lt 2.5 (Monday-Wednesday) to hold through Sunday and exit at the next weekday opportunity.
'kinda going up' would be close above SMA(20) with sweep, but it is left out of the executable rule for the reason above.

evidence.quote: sells on Saturday, and buys back the next Wednesday
set your chart time period to 1 day

audit_majors: exit[0]: Claim says cover 'next Wednesday' - single weekday. Spec encodes day_of_week lt 2.5 which triggers on Monday-Tuesday-Wednesday, exiting early.
exit: Claim conditions cover on 'if the price is kinda going up'. Spec omits any price-trend filter and covers on weekday alone, changing what is tested.
